updates.body:
We're investigating a new incident.
Current impact to end users: Some users may experience trouble sending messages. We're investigating the issue and we regret any inconvenience this is causing.
We'll provide an update within 30 minutes including further details on current actions being taken.

We are actively working to resolve the current platform functionality issues.
Current status and actions being taken: We've identified a fix and are actively deploying it across the platform. Once the rollout is complete, we'll monitor system performance to ensure full stability.
Estimated time to resolution: No ETA at this time.
Scope: This issue isn't affecting any specific region, but a percentage of users may be affected globally.
Current impact to end users: Some users may experience trouble sending messages.
Known workarounds: No known workarounds at this time.
We appreciate your patience as we sort this out.

Scope: This issue isn't affecting any specific region, but a percentage of users may be affected globally.
Current impact to end users: Some users may experience trouble sending messages.

We'll continue to provide updates every 60 minutes until the impact is resolved for all users.

We are actively working to resolve the current platform functionality issues.
Current status and actions being taken: We're still working toward resolving the issue and to reduce the likelihood of symptoms recurring. We'll continue to monitor internal metrics as we work through this.
Estimated time to resolution: No ETA at this time.

We'll provide the next update upon a significant change in status, or sooner if additional information becomes available.

This issue is now resolved for all users.
Current status and recent actions taken: After monitoring system performance and infrastructure stability, we have confirmed that all Slack features are operating within expected levels. Users should no longer experience any issues when sending messages.
